clause_i.reason: For a target-specific grouped mode such as selected_contain_button, seeded very-dense positions, hidden strain identity, and the currently active stage vary, so no action function using only I_t can select the required visible target across all histories. A visual policy can choose the current wave's target, but this is static causal search rather than delayed-state prediction.

clause_ii.reason: A bounded current screenshot identifies the active wave, visible live windows, red infected parents or echoes, selectable labels, the current well, and each newly activated stage. Any uninfected live window is a valid next probe, so a one-frame visual policy is sufficient.

clause_iii.reason: No autonomous gameplay process makes a close, resistance, selection, or proxy-containment action unavailable or strictly less effective after a positive delay. The 320 ms arrival effect follows an agent containment action and only changes a CSS class; wave activation, well relocation, and live-set changes are synchronous action consequences.

configuration_reports.common_visible_process: The only visible autonomous changes are CSS progress, infected jitter, well hue, and the short arrival animation after an agent-triggered stage activation. The gameplay state does not advance autonomously between actions, and the final purge is post-submission cleanup. No common visible process both selects the delayed-optimal action and degrades its opportunity.

pre_run.reason: The mathematical definition already gives No because clause (iii) has no witness; the pre-run override is therefore not applicable.
